story_description: Build the settings window foundation, navigation, categories, and search.
task_description: Users need to search settings by keyword. A view model handles search logic, filtering categories and individual settings, and highlighting matches.
atom_description: Users need to search settings by keyword. A view model handles search logic, filtering categories and individual settings, and highlighting matches.
problem_statement: Users need to search settings by keyword. A view model handles search logic, filtering categories and individual settings, and highlighting matches.
scope_in: Search query processing; category filtering; settings item filtering; search result ranking
Implement SettingsSearchViewModel.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Each settings category provides searchable terms
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Search must be responsive (<100ms for typical query)
Must highlight matching terms in results
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
Default window size 1200 x 800 and resizable
Transparent titlebar with traffic lights visible
Background clear, isOpaque false, shadow enabled
functional_requirements: Filter individual settings by label/description match
Return ranked results with match highlights
Debounce input to avoid excessive filtering
Index category names, setting labels, and keywords for search.
Return ranked results and highlight matching text.
Provide a stable sort order for identical scores.
implementation_steps: Add result ranking (exact match > prefix > contains)
Review the SettingsSearchViewModel.swift section in docs/settings-development.md and confirm required fields and flows.
event_contracts: Event contracts are defined through telemetry events for this atom.
No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_interactions: User clears query → All categories restored
ui_copy: Section headers are localized and match the category name.
Control labels match the setting names listed in functional requirements.
edge_cases: Query with only whitespace - treat as empty
Very long query - truncate at 100 chars
Special characters - escape for safe matching
failure_modes: Regex crash on invalid pattern - fall back to contains() match
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Remove search functionality; sidebar shows all categories always

integration: Integration test SettingsSearchViewModel.swift with dependent stores or managers.
Verify persistence round trips when settings are updated.
ui: Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
security: Ensure no sensitive data is logged.
Verify file permissions for any on-disk artifacts.

log_expectations: INFO: settings update applied with key and new value
acceptance_tests: Type "git" in search → Git category shown
Open the Settings UI and verify the expected controls and behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Functional requirements are implemented as specified.
completed_when: All definition of done criteria are met and verification steps pass.
completed_evidence: Passing tests, verification steps completed, and artifact outputs present.
open_questions: No open questions; specification is complete for this atom.
